customer_name: Yunnan Communications Investment and Construction Group
business_problem: Yunnan Jiaotou needed a transport-domain AI system that could handle complex mountain highway construction, maintenance, operations, and safety workflows, but no mature transportation large model, no high-quality domain dataset, and no multi-model orchestration approach existed for the sector.
solution_summary: Yunnan Communications Investment and Construction Group built the 'Green Beautiful Corridor' transportation large model on Huawei Cloud Stack to support highway construction, operations, maintenance, safety, and office work. The platform uses a cloud-edge-end architecture with one data center, one disaster-recovery center, and 35 edge nodes. Huawei also supplied an AI toolchain for data engineering, model engineering, agent development, and O&M, plus transport datasets with over 600 GB of industry corpus and 400 GB of enterprise knowledge. On that base, the team created four model families for industry understanding, traffic-state sensing and forecasting, multimodal perception, and decision generation and optimization. Those models power 30+ applications including traffic forecasting from toll, gantry, road, event, and weather data, as well as BIM review, drone inspection, video-based unsafe-behavior detection, and AI emergency-duty workflows.

data_flow: Traffic flows, speeds, incidents, weather feeds, toll-station and gantry data, BIM drawings, drone imagery, and site video are collected into the cloud-edge-end platform and high-quality transport datasets. The large-model stack trains and serves forecasting and perception models, which then feed traffic-control decisions, construction review, safety alerts, and emergency-duty workflows.
